scope: Small early valuation sale and fast invalidation, with native defenses and valuation memory preserved
hypothesis: Selling only half the native-to-30% gap and restoring the native target when its pending defense confirmation breaks may reduce the opportunity cost of false early selling.
reference: Archived REENTRY_BUY / memory REFERENCE: guarded residual-cash-half reentry plus conditional BUY acceleration
control: FULL_SLOW must reproduce the archived MEMORY_VAL policy in all six cases, not just improve upon its failed return
entry: Identical to qqq_memory_sell: after native evaluation, defense_mode WARNING, pending native DEFENSE candidate >=2 consecutive sessions, existing 20/252-day down disagreement >=2 sessions. No new sell signal or faster trend BEAR entry.

sizing.formula: native QQQ - fraction * max(native QQQ - 0.30, 0). Recompute from today's native target, not recursively from yesterday's reduced target.
sizing.half_examples: Native 100% -> 65%, native 70% -> 50%, native 20% -> unchanged 20%. Native DEFENSE confirmation immediately hands over to its full native target, e.g. 30%.
sizing.reason: Half is a single predeclared reduction of the previous sale; no size grid or fitted risk budget. This is not the old 21/63-session fixed-hold HALF_ADJUST experiment.

release.slow: Identical to archived MEMORY_VAL: while native WARNING, recovery_score>=4 and QQQ close>EMA20 for two consecutive sessions; native departure from WARNING releases or hands off immediately.
release.fast: In addition to slow release, while native WARNING, release on the first completed close whose native pending DEFENSE candidate is absent or has a different desired value. Check only after an entry day, so entry and invalidation cannot occur together. A lost down-disagreement alone does not release the overlay.
release.execution: Release decision restores today's native target through the same next-open order clock, not today's close. On release, Method 1 additions still require their ordinary weekly gate. Native defense and all other guard priorities take precedence.
release.rearming: No added cooldown: reentry requires the same native >=2-day candidate and >=2-day disagreement again. All repeat entries and their costs are reported.

preserved: All native state rules and pending counters
Actual changed holdings passed to the source
No Method 1 addition during early selling
Existing 7.5pp deviation/4pp underweight bands and order deadlines
matrix: 60 runs: 30 MAIN runs (3 periods x 2 sources x 5 profiles) and 30 CURRENT stress runs (3 stresses x 2 sources x 5 profiles). Prefix rerun all 30 MAIN paths.

gate.concentration: Report all years and events; concentration alone is not a rejection
gate.meaning: Historical incremental evidence, not production adoption or guaranteed future performance

limitations: Hypothesis designed after seeing prior failures
Old-crisis CAPE/cash proxy and publication-time limitations inherited
No new paid data, live fills, parameter sweep or learning model
